step1_analysis.description: A sub-circuit extracted from a pipeline ADC, likely part of a folded-cascode or gain-boosted operational amplifier. The netlist appears to be a partial or distorted extraction with several diode-connected and floating nodes, but it structurally resembles a differential gain stage.

paper_reference.title: A 14-b 12-MS/s CMOS Pipeline ADC With Over 100-dB SFDR

sky130_expected.calculation: gm * Rout. For a standard diff pair, gain is ~gm*ro. Here, due to the broken extraction (e.g., diode-connected loads, floating nodes), the gain will be very low or unpredictable.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The netlist is a partial extraction with diode-connected loads and floating nodes, so it will not achieve the 130 dB reported for the full nested gain-boosted op-amp.

Unity_Gain_Frequency.description: Frequency where differential gain drops to 0 dB

sky130_expected.calculation: gm / (2*pi*CL). With gm ~ 1mS and CL = 1pF, UGF ~ 160 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the arbitrary load capacitance and the actual transconductance of the partial circuit.

sky130_expected.calculation: VDD * I_total. With 0.9V bias on current sources, I_tail is roughly 100uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 98 mW is for the entire 14-bit ADC. This single sub-circuit will consume a fraction of a milliwatt to a few milliwatts.

Phase_Margin.description: Phase margin at unity gain frequency

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard stability metric, though its value is arbitrary for a broken open-loop subcircuit.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC differential gain, bandwidth, phase margin, and transient swing of the extracted sub-circuit.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for extracted op-amp subcircuit
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

XM1 N1 VI_PLUS N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 VI_MINUS N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VO_MINUS N5 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N0 LABEL_NET_2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 VO_PLUS N6 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N1 LABEL_NET_3 VO_MINUS VO_MINUS sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N1 N1 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N1 N1 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 VO_PLUS LABEL_NET_5 N1 N6 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

* Power and Bias
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_5 LABEL_NET_5 0 0.9

* Fix floating nodes to prevent singular matrix
R_N4 N4 0 10k
V_N5 N5 0 0.9
V_N6 N6 0 0.9

* Input Signals
VCM VCM 0 0.9
V_INP VI_PLUS VCM dc 0 ac 0.5 sin(0 0.1 1Meg)
V_INN VI_MINUS VCM dc 0 ac -0.5 sin(0 -0.1 1Meg)

* Loads
R_OUTP VO_PLUS 0 1Meg
R_OUTN VO_MINUS 0 1Meg
C_OUTP VO_PLUS 0 1p
C_OUTN VO_MINUS 0 1p

* Differential Output
E_diff VDIFF 0 VO_PLUS VO_MINUS 1.0

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD)*1.8
print power

ac dec 20 1 1G
let gain_db = vdb(VDIFF)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(VDIFF))
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
let gain_3db = $&dc_gain - 3
meas ac f_3db when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1
meas ac ugf when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac pm find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1

tran 1n 5u
meas tran vout_max max v(VDIFF)
meas tran vout_min min v(VDIFF)
meas tran vout_pp pp v(VDIFF)

quit
.endc
